mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_join_request(guild_kind, guild_id, member_id, invite_id, message, status) VALUES (#{guildKind}, #{guildId}, #{memberId}, #{inviteId}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, guild_kind AS guildKind, guild_id AS guildId, member_id AS memberId, status FROM im_join_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_join_request SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reject_reason_code = #{reasonCode}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_space_admission(guild_kind, guild_id, join_paused, paused_until, reason, update_by) VALUES (#{guildKind}, #{guildId}, #{paused}, #{until}, #{reason}, #{operator}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE join_paused = VALUES(join_paused), paused_until = VALUES(paused_until), reason = VALUES(reason), update_by = VALUES(update_by)
